problem:
Solve the following system of linear equations by finding the inverse of the coefficient matrix:

$$
{\begin{aligned}y+z=1 \\ 2x-2z=2+2y \\ 2y+4z=2x-2\end{aligned}
$$

Find  $x+y+z.$

feedback.problem: Consider a matrix equation ${A}^{-1}\,x={B}^{-1}\,d,$ where $A$ and $B$ are $5\times 5$ non-singular matrices, while $x$ and $d$ are $5\times 1$ column vectors. Solve the equation for $x.$
feedback.worked_solution:
Pre-multiplying both sides of the equation ${A}^{-1}\,x={B}^{-1}\,d$ by $A,$ we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{A}^{-1}\,x & ={B}^{-1}\,d \\ A{A}^{-1}\,x & =A{B}^{-1}\,d \\ {I}_{5}\,x & =A{B}^{-1}\,d \\ x & =A{B}^{-1}\,d.\end{aligned}
$$
